findings.message: `RCM_multi_data.tex` is not in the package; the documentation (README.md) says to download it from https://doi.org/10.1093/ej/uez039, https://doi.org/10.1093/ej/uez039. The download date and the file's SHA-256 become part of the receipt; links were not checked (use --check-links).

Files the code both writes and reads are already in the package: collective_choice_data.csv. A run may read these instead of recomputing them. A receipt must say whether it replayed them or recomputed them, and a matching output hash alone does not show recomputation.
No licence file and no licence named in the documentation. Running it for a check is unaffected, but a receipt should quote and hash files rather than redistribute them.
